entries.reason: the mode an extension declares it can be shown in is a statement to the panel, and this release has no Notification Center, no Today widget and no widget host, so there is no panel for a widget to be shown in; nothing reads it, so a value the port kept here would be one the application could read back and never see honoured
entries.effect: the accessor is not carried: respondsToSelector: answers NO for it and its setter, and an unchecked call is a crash the application must avoid
entries.source: the header of NCWidgetProviding.h in SDK 26.2; iOS 6.1.3 carries no Notification Center surface at all, read from its armv7 cache
